label: Autoland
description: TenHands' hadoku-task-automation pipeline. One board per repo. Spitball thoughts land untagged in the Inbox; the pipeline claims them into `planning`, interprets them, and writes a plan plus clarifying questions into `notes`. The human answers in `plan-review` and either sends it back for another planning pass or drags it to `approved`. From `approved` onward the work runs unattended: the working agent implements end to end, gates run, and the change arrives as a pull request for you to review and merge. You are asked for two things and no more — sign off the plan before the work, and merge the pull request after it.

lanes.label: Planning
lanes.description: Reading the raw thought, interpreting intent, designing a plan, and writing it plus any clarifying questions into notes.

lanes.label: Plan Review
lanes.description: The plan and its open questions are in notes. Answer them or disagree, then drag back to Re-plan for another pass — or to Approved if you're happy. This is the only lane that asks anything of you.

lanes.label: Re-plan
lanes.description: You answered or objected. Hand it back for another planning pass. The pipeline claims from here.

lanes.label: Approved
lanes.description: Plan signed off. From here it lands without you. The pipeline claims from here.

lanes.label: Working
lanes.description: Implementing the approved plan end to end in a git worktree: reproduce, fix, verify, gates, and a capped remediation loop if a gate fails.

lanes.label: Landing
lanes.description: Gates green. Pushing the branch and opening a pull request against main.

lanes.label: Landed
lanes.description: The pull request is open, gates green, and waiting on you. Review it and merge — this is the last thing asked of you.

lanes.label: Stalled
lanes.description: A gate failed after remediation, the planning loop hit its iteration cap, or the change landed and was auto-reverted. Reason and evidence are in notes.
